meta.title: Broker agents: where we started and where we were headed
meta.subtitle: Brokers got intelligence from Northwind's Snowflake data through Data Cloud. First it came through three Employee Agents. Next it was going to come through Agentforce Coworker skills.

views.title: First iteration: three Employee Agents
views.intro: Each use case was its own Employee Agent in the Salesforce sidebar. The agents queried Data Cloud data lake objects that were streamed in from Snowflake.

nodes.title: Brokers
nodes.sub: Brokers and analysts researching deals and lending

nodes.title: Employee Agents
nodes.sub: One agent per use case, in the Salesforce sidebar

nodes.title: Snowflake
nodes.sub: Northwind's deal, listing and lending data

steps.title: Brokers pick an agent
steps.text: A broker opens the agent for their question: market trends, loan quotes or client research.

steps.title: The agent queries Data Cloud
steps.text: Each agent reads the DLOs directly and summarizes results before they reach the model.

steps.title: Snowflake streams in
steps.text: Northwind's Snowflake tables sync into Data Cloud by streaming, so the DLOs stay current.

views.title: What we positioned: Coworker skills
views.intro: One Coworker experience in place of separate agents. Skills load based on what each person asks for, and they call the same Snowflake-backed data through Data Cloud DMOs.

steps.title: One place to ask
steps.text: Brokers work in Agentforce Coworker instead of choosing between separate agents.

steps.title: Skills call Data Cloud
steps.text: Coworker picks the right skill for the request and reads the Data Cloud DMOs.

steps.title: Same data underneath
steps.text: The Snowflake streaming sync stays as it was, so nothing changes at the data layer.

cards.title: Built
cards.text: Market Trends and Deal Finder ran as Employee Agents on Data Cloud data streamed from Snowflake.

cards.title: Why we moved
cards.text: Separate sidebar agents were doing a job Coworker is built for. Coworker gives one experience with skills per request and the same data underneath.

cards.title: Cancelled
cards.text: Northwind paused the program, before the Coworker pilot ran.
